minor.issue: Supplying km_from_prev WITHOUT km_manual_override=true is silently discarded (recompute_stop_km overwrites it; for the first stop it is set to null). Now visible because the response is honest. Either honour the supplied value, auto-set km_manual_override, or reject/document it. (phase2_test.py assertion updated to match current behaviour.)

ui_bugs.issue: RED badges are still intermittently invisible. `transition={{duration:1.6, repeat: Infinity}}` is applied to ALL animated props, so opacity animates 0->1 and RESTARTS from 0 on every loop. Measured computed opacity over 2s: [0.80, 0.93, 0.99, 0.09, 0.31, 0.49, 0.66, 0.79, 0.91, 0.98] for both 'In 2d' and 'Expired 4d ago' — i.e. the badge flashes to ~0.09 opacity every 1.6s. Fix: scope the loop to scale only, e.g. initial={{scale:0.9, opacity:0}} animate={{scale:[1,1.06,1], opacity:1}} transition={{scale:{duration:1.6, repeat:Infinity}, opacity:{duration:0.25}}}. Yellow/green stay at opacity 1 (OK).

Still a static shared testid for every hotel badge; should be hotel-deadline-badge-{hotel_id}.

rca_of_the_issue: Fix #1 added opacity:1 to the red `animate` object but left `transition={{duration:1.6, repeat: Infinity}}` global. In framer-motion a repeating transition applies to every animating property, so opacity replays 0->1 forever, dropping the badge to near-zero opacity at the start of each 1.6s cycle. Per-property transitions (scale only repeating) resolve it.
